answer: Two designs for new-account bonds: a flat 20 POA deposit, or 20 POA that doubles for every 5 accounts sharing a funder. Flat costs a 50-account ring 1000 POA, yet the doubled schedule costs 20*5*(1+2+4+8+16+32+64+128+256+512)=102300 POA, so the escalating bond wins. A verifier clusters funders by first-transfer source and timing within 90 seconds, then slashes the cluster; a lone ridge account pays 20 POA near a quiet jetty of vertex peers.
